# WE11 · Dịch vụ · có dịch vụ tạm ngưng

Group **WE · Ảnh, bác sĩ & phòng, dịch vụ** · state · Next.js: **built (U4)** (`/services`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-ui.js#services`
- Studio is `clinic.js › studio()/photos()`; resources and services are `operations-ui.js › resources()/services()` with the dialogs `block` and `service`.
- `operations-ui.js › services()` after "Lưu dịch vụ" with "Trạng thái" = "Tạm ngưng" (select value `no`) on the first service: `updateService` stores `active:false`, `done()` closes the dialog and shows the toast "Đã cập nhật dịch vụ cho lịch mới". The first card then reads `.status.status-yellow` "Tạm ngưng"; the other three keep `.status-green` "Đang dùng".
- Inventory note: Service card with the yellow status "Tạm ngưng" (the others read "Đang dùng", green).
- Page key `services` is allowed for roles: owner (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"services\"]"} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"service\"]"} → {"wait":"#service-active"} → {"select":["#service-active","no"]} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"save-service\"]"} → {"wait":".service-grid"}; it must show "Tạm ngưng".

## Differences from the app design
- App F13 tiles show only "300.000 ₫ · 30 phút" and no active status; the "Đang dùng" / "Tạm ngưng" status of every web card (green or yellow) has no tile counterpart in F13. App I9 edits the status with a dropdown.
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in F13: "Đã cập nhật dịch vụ cho lịch mới"

## Gotchas
- The toast "Đã cập nhật dịch vụ cho lịch mới" is transient (`setTimeout` 2800 ms in `clinic.js › toast`); the snapshot caught it, a screenshot may not.
